title: AMBLM ext day applause people crowd walla open air concert berlin philharmonics international german english by LudwigMueller
author: LudwigMueller
sourceDescription: Stereo ambience of people applauding at the end of an open air concert by the Berlin Philharmonics. Unfortunately, I arrived too late to catch the beginning of the applause, but hey, better than nothing :) I was standing on a concrete block a little bit above the audience but still pretty close, maybe 6 meters away from the nearest person. The concert took place at the Kulturforum, a large open concrete space next to the Berlin Philharmonic Hall. It's a warm summer evening.
